# WayfinderGEO

> WayfinderGEO helps brands get named, quoted and linked in AI answers. It brings together
> Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), AI optimization (AIO) and SEO as one system, and
> measures success in citations and share of voice rather than keyword rankings.

Based in Cleveland, Ohio. Serving clients across Canada and the United States.

## Why it matters

Buyers now ask an AI and get one short answer instead of ten links. Brands named in that
answer make the shortlist; brands that aren't might as well be invisible. Each month a brand
stays out of those answers, a competitor settles in as the default recommendation in its
category.

## What WayfinderGEO does

- **GEO (Generative Engine Optimization):** getting a brand named, quoted and linked in AI
  answers to the questions its buyers ask. Includes finding those questions and tracking how
  often the brand is named, seeing where competitors get cited and it doesn't, pages written
  so an AI can quote them cleanly, making sure models know exactly who the brand is, and
  mentions on the sites AI engines already trust.
- **AIO (AI optimization and readability):** making a site easy for AI crawlers to read,
  quote and credit. Includes structured data (schema), llms.txt, crawler access and AI bot
  logs, headings and sections an AI can lift straight into an answer, speed and Core Web
  Vitals, and keeping key pages up to date.
- **SEO (foundational search):** AI answers still start from search results, so a brand that
  is hard to find there is hard to quote. Includes technical audits and crawl health, topical
  authority and internal linking, content planned around what buyers search for, local and
  multi-location visibility, and digital PR with links from trusted sites.

## AI engines tracked

ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews and AI Mode, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude and Grok, plus the
sources they lean on: Reddit, YouTube and review sites.

## Plans

- **Beacon: $500 per month.** For small and local businesses that want someone handling this
  every month. A full check of how AI sees the business and the behind-the-scenes fixes (schema,
  llms.txt, crawler access) in the first month, 50 customer questions tracked on Google AI,
  ChatGPT and Gemini, two new pages a month that answer those questions, Google Business Profile
  kept fresh plus an easy way to get more reviews, Google SEO basics (page titles, speed, broken
  links), and a plain-English report every month on what moved.
- **North Star: $1,500 per month.** For brands that want the spot AI keeps giving to a
  competitor. Everything in Beacon, 200 questions tracked across 6 AI tools (Google AI, ChatGPT,
  Gemini, Perplexity, Claude and Copilot), six new pages a month, mentions on the sites AI trusts
  (press, directories, review sites and "best of" lists), a live dashboard of how often AI picks
  the brand over named competitors, and entity work so AI has the business facts right.
- **Compass: $1,250, one payment.** Get the full picture and the basics fixed once, without a
  monthly bill. 50 customer questions checked across 6 AI tools, which competitors AI recommends
  instead and why, the behind-the-scenes fixes, Google Business Profile and basic SEO problems
  fixed, a 90-day plan with a walkthrough call and a recheck at the end. Nothing is redone or
  charged twice if the client moves to a monthly plan later.
- **New websites, priced separately.** Clean, minimal sites of one to four pages, optimized for
  AI. Bigger builds go to the UI/UX designers at Crispy Studio (https://crispy.studio).

No setup fee, no lock-in contract and no percentage of ad spend. Compass is a single payment
with nothing after it. Monthly plans run month to month; we recommend giving it 90 days.
Multi-location, ecommerce catalogue and enterprise scopes are quoted separately. Every
engagement can start with a free AI visibility audit: which engines mention the brand, the
prompts where it's missing, and which competitors take the slot instead.

## How engagements run

1. **Week 1, Where you stand:** a score for your brand on every major AI engine, free, before anything is billed.
2. **Month 1, Groundwork:** the first fixes go live, and AI crawler visits to your site become visible.
3. **Month 3, Proof:** citations tracked month by month, showing what is working.
4. **Month 6 and on, Momentum:** each new page and mention adds to the last, and share of voice grows.

Technical fixes register within weeks; citation share generally moves between month two and
month four, depending on the category.

## What WayfinderGEO does not claim

It influences what AI models say about a brand; it does not control it. It works on the
brand's own content, the signals that tell models who the brand is, and the wider record of
what the internet says about it.

## Clients

Cleanmeter, IBFNet Group, Crispy Studio, GoodDay, Candata and Imaara.
